item.title: RoboTrack: Point tracking for real-world robotic manipulation
item.description: RoboTrack introduces a new benchmark, synthetic training dataset, and two models that improve how robots track objects during real-world manipulation tasks.

item.title: Theorizer comes to Asta
item.description: Theorizer in Asta connects scientific literature to proposed explanations that researchers can examine and test.

item.title: Ai2 and Taylor Geospatial partner to make geospatial AI easier to compare, run, and build on
item.description: Ai2 and Taylor Geospatial are partnering to make geospatial AI more accessible and useful for the public good through open models, shared benchmarks, and improved satellite imagery datasets for applications in conservation, agriculture, and humanitarian work.

item.title: XYBench: Helping with the problem behind the question
item.description: XYBench is an 8,115-question benchmark testing whether LLMs spot misconceptions in user requests and redirect toward the user’s underlying goal.

item.title: ToyBlocks: A controlled world for robot learning and evaluation
item.description: ToyBlocks is an open simulation framework for studying robot learning through automated task generation, training demonstrations, and evaluation in a controlled tabletop world.
